question: List a combined report that UNION ALLs (1) per-migration-status instance memory statistics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), for instances with a matching migration record and non-NULL memory) and (2) per-VM-state instance root disk statistics (average, range, and variance, for non-deleted instances with an INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA key of 'image_image_type' and a matching INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES row), including a “reason” column indicating which set each row came from. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  m.status AS status,
  AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory,
  VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance_memory,
  STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS stddev_memory,
  'migration_status' AS reason
FROM instances i
JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE i.memory_mb IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m.status
UNION ALL
SELECT
  i.vm_state AS status,
  AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root,
  MAX(i.root_gb) - MIN(i.root_gb) AS range_root,
  VARIANCE(i.root_gb) AS variance_root,
  'vm_state' AS reason
FROM instances i
JOIN instance_system_metadata s ON s.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND s.`key` = 'image_image_type'
JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE i.deleted = 0
GROUP BY i.vm_state
